capabilities: Sync scrolling between two side-by-side panes by percentage
Jump the other pane to the same line via triple-click
Maintain the relative offset while scrolling after a line jump
Sync in both directions, left-to-right and right-to-left
Enable and disable syncing from the command palette
motivation: The author translates English technical documents into Chinese in Obsidian and found the constant back-and-forth between source and translation tedious, especially when documents differ in length.
problem: Obsidian panes scroll independently, so comparing or translating two documents side by side requires constant manual re-scrolling to stay aligned.
summary: Side-by-side scrolling sync that links two file panes and aligns them line-by-line on triple-click, for comparing documents or reading translations.
